messages:
sasha_support: FYI — customer reported rerank endpoint returning \"model_deprecated\" and all scores 0.0 after we rolled the model alias last night. They called the endpoint with \`model: \"rerank-1\"\`. They also attached a curl repro and a score dump.

sasha_support: API response (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"error\": \"model_deprecated\",
  \"message\": \"the model 'rerank-1' is deprecated; please use 'rerank-2' or contact support for migration\"
}
```

emma_support: Thanks. Can you paste the exact request body they used? Any headers (x-model-alias etc)? Did they hit hosted or dedicated?

sasha_support: Hosted (us-west1). Request body they provided: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rerank-1","queries":["find best doc"],"candidates":["docA","docB"]}'
```
They said scores used to be nonzero, now back 0.0 or sometimes tiny negative numbers. Also saw a 429 once after retries.

ben_devx: Reproduced locally in staging against hosted edge with same request. Getting the same error + empty scoring vector. Quick log snippet from proxy: 
```
2026-03-12T14:03:02Z INFO request id=rr-8d3 model=requested:rerank-1 routed-to:rerank-2
2026-03-12T14:03:02Z WARN model-mismatch id=rerank-1 resolver:alias->rerank-2 (deprecated)
2026-03-12T14:03:02Z ERROR runtime:score_output length=0
```
Looks like alias mapping happened but runtime path still expects v1 scoring schema, ended up returning empty vector due to shape mismatch.

maya_ml: Quick context: rerank-1 used a different normalization and returned dense floats length N. rerank-2 changed tokenizer and returns calibrated logits. We deprecated rerank-1 id last week and updated alias table to point to rerank-2. We didn't add a compatibility shim for the scoring schema. That can cause consumers expecting exact vector shapes to break.

maya_ml: Proposed fixes:
- Short term: add alias mapping in the frontend to reject old id with clear 400 telling user to switch to rerank-2 (we can revert to that behavior immediately).
- Medium: implement a runtime compatibility layer that maps/runs a conversion for rerank-1 requests -> rerank-2 outputs (score normalization) for x days.
- Long: notify customers proactively and bump SDKs/docs.

tom_runtime: Agree with maya. I can ship a hotfix to runtime that detects requested id=rerank-1 and runs the post-processing conversion. Low risk but need a fast test. Will open PR and run canary.

ben_devx: Temp mitigation we gave to customer: explicitly set \`model: \"rerank-2\"\` in body or set header \`X-Model-Override: rerank-2\` — that makes requests succeed with expected nonzero scores. Provided them a one-off snippet.

emma_support: Do we have a way to detect how many customers are still calling rerank-1? Would like metrics + alert to avoid repeat.

infra-bot: [job started] scan-legacy-model-usage run-id=scan-1789502468 by=emma_support

ben_devx: I added a temporary log-level counter for deprecated-model-call in proxy and a graphed metric (internal dashboard). Initial scan shows ~8 active API keys in last 24h calling rerank-1.

maya_ml: If tom can ship hotfix, we should backfill conversion rule for 72 hours and then respond to clients to migrate. I'll draft the conversion mapping (normalization factors).

tom_runtime: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/412 (wip). Will mark for hot canary to Dedicated and Hosted. Deploy bot kicking off test.

deploy-bot: started deployment runtime/hotfix-412 -> canary-hosted-us-west1

ben_devx: Repro steps I used (staging):
1) set API_TOKEN to staging key
2) curl to https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank with body model:rerank-1 and payload from above
3) observe 400 or model_deprecated + empty scores in response
Workaround: change model to rerank-2 and re-run.

maya_ml: I'll post the exact normalization formula in the PR description so tom can include conversion.

sasha_support: Next actions (assignments):
- tom_runtime: hotfix + canary (ETA 2h)
- maya_ml: conversion spec + confirm accuracy (ETA 3h)
- ben_devx: rollout dashboard + contact list of affected API keys (ETA 1h)
- emma_support: message templates for customers + one-off mitigation steps (ETA 1h)

sasha_support: I'll follow up with the customer with the temporary workaround and tell them we're rolling a compatibility patch shortly. Will update here when they confirm the workaround works. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary deployment succeeded runtime/hotfix-412 -> canary-hosted-us-west1 (12:35 UTC)

ben_devx: Hotfix validated in canary: rerank-1 requests now return normalized nonzero scores for existing payloads. Monitoring shows conversion latency +8ms p95.

sasha_support: Closing loop — customer confirmed their integration is back to normal after we applied the hotfix and they tried explicit workaround. They'll migrate to rerank-2 soon. I'll keep this thread open until metric for deprecated-model-call is < 1/day for a week.

sasha_support: Thanks all, nice cross-team response.
